relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings demonstrated that, compared to control mice, intrathecal administration of AAV-MDFIC2 significantly elevated DRG MDFIC2 mRNA expression levels and markedly attenuated mechanical allodynia in SNI mice

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings collectively demonstrate that nerve injury significantly downregulates Mdfic2 expression in DRG

key_findings: MDFIC2 is expressed in nonpeptidergic and a subset of CGRP+ DRG neurons and slows PIEZO1/2 kinetics and raises activation threshold.
Mdfic2 is downregulated after nerve injury and AAV-MDFIC2 overexpression attenuates SNI mechanical allodynia.
